title: PoVi: Agentic Poetry-to-Video Generation with Knowledge Grounding and Figurative Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2611.34690v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Poetry-to-video generation requires more than translating text into visual scenes. Poetic language is highly compressed, often depends on historical and cultural knowledge, and frequently conveys meaning through metaphor, imagery, and other non-literal expressions. We introduce PoVi, a benchmark and agentic framework for grounded poetry-to-video generation, evaluating semantic grounding, discourse coherence, and audiovisual realization. PoVi reconstructs poem semantics into an evidence-bounded representation and progressively transforms them into narration, interpretation, character assets, and shot-level visual plans, followed by narration-aligned video generation. Across three planning backbones and four video generators, PoVi consistently improves over single-call generation, with the largest gains on implicit background knowledge and metaphorical relations. PoVi provides a testbed for studying knowledge-grounded, long-horizon multimo

translated_title: PoVi：基于知识接地与修辞理解的智能体诗歌到视频生成
translated_abstract: 诗歌到视频生成不仅仅是将文本翻译成视觉场景。诗歌语言高度凝练，往往依赖历史与文化知识，并经常通过隐喻、意象及其他非字面表达来传递意义。我们提出 PoVi，一个面向知识接地的诗歌到视频生成的基准与智能体框架，用于评估语义接地、语篇连贯性和视听呈现效果。PoVi 将诗歌语义重构为证据约束的表示，并逐步将其转化为旁白、解读、角色资产和镜头级视觉规划，随后生成与旁白对齐的视频。在三种规划骨干模型和四种视频生成器上的实验表明，PoVi 始终优于单次调用式生成，其中在隐含背景知识和隐喻关系方面提升最大。PoVi 为研究知识接地、长程多模态生成提供了测试平台。
tldr: PoVi 提出了一个结合知识接地与修辞理解的智能体框架和基准，将诗歌语义逐步转化为旁白、解读与镜头级视觉规划，显著提升了诗歌视频生成在隐含知识和隐喻表达上的表现。
en_tdlr: PoVi introduces an agentic benchmark and framework that grounds poetry semantics in cultural knowledge and figurative understanding, progressively transforming poems into narration, interpretation, and shot-level visual plans to significantly improve poetry-to-video generation, especially on implicit background knowledge and metaphorical relations.
